name: My Government-Mandated GF
source:
A short kinetic novel about a couple meeting under forced circumstances and falling in love regardless.

Live your first days as a man welcoming his own government-mandated girlfriend Clelia into his house. Get to know her personality, her interests... and maybe a bit more than that too, if you catch my drift.

[From [url=https://erosandwich.itch.io/my-government-mandated-gf]itch.io[/url]]
